Snapshot.Empty.zh: 选区内没有可截取内容
Snapshot.Empty.en: There is no content to capture in the selection.

Snapshot.Inserted.zh: 静像已原位插入，可继续圈选或调整图片。
Snapshot.Inserted.en: Snapshot inserted in place. Select another region or adjust the image.

Snapshot.Failed.zh: 截图失败，原有画布内容已保留：
Snapshot.Failed.en: Snapshot failed. Existing canvas content is preserved:

Snapshot.FailureLog.zh: 截图未完成，原有内容已保留。诊断日志：{0}
Snapshot.FailureLog.en: Snapshot was not completed. Existing content is preserved. Diagnostic log: {0}

Snapshot.FailureLogUnavailable.zh: 截图未完成，原有内容已保留。无法写入诊断日志，请检查目录：{0}
Snapshot.FailureLogUnavailable.en: Snapshot was not completed. Existing content is preserved. The diagnostic log could not be written. Check: {0}
